description: The Phase 0 probe benchmarks individual ONNX graphs (op coverage, per-step latency, drift). plan.md §6.1 requires timing the complete streaming loop: feature extraction (fbank for CAM++/WeSpeaker/ECAPA, log-mel for Whisper/Qwen3-ASR, nemo128 for Parakeet), tensor upload, autoregressive decode with KV cache, readback, and real audio (use G2 WAVs uploaded by the capture spike). Prefer @huggingface/transformers (v4.x, supports WebNN devices) where it supports the model instead of hand-rolling decode loops; fall back to ORT only for unsupported models. Also add semantic known-answer checks: VAD on labeled speech, same/different-speaker cosine for embeddings, WER on a short reference clip.
title: End-to-end local pipeline benchmarks (features + decode loops), prefer @huggingface/transformers
